Forwards a user message to the agent and streams the agent's progress as Server-Sent Events (SSE).
The stream starts with an X-Session-ID response header set to the session ID (new or existing).
Each line is `data: <json>` where the JSON is a StreamPacket: { "type": "...", "missionId": "...", "step": number, "seq": number, "timestamp": number }.
Packet types: metadata, reasoning, content, tool_call, tool_result, tool_skip, todo, subagent_call, subagent_result, usage, progress, heartbeat, state_change, degraded, turn_complete, debug, error, system_notice, token_metrics, hitl_approval_required, mission_completed.
Terminal packets: turn_complete, mission_completed, error.
If the connection drops mid-run, the mission is cancelled (token safety) and the turn is finalized as interrupted — send a new message to continue.
See docs/shared/contracts/json-api-contract.md §SSE Event Format for the full schema.
